# Blast radius before depth

`customer_support.pb.root_cause_analysis.blast_radius_before_depth` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Map who is affected before going deep on anyone. Search every ticket carrying this symptom, attach them to a single issue, and look at what the affected share and what the unaffected do not.

Depth on a single-account defect is the most expensive way to be right, and the shape of the affected population constrains the cause before a single log line is read. It also stops the same fault being investigated three times in parallel by three agents.
